# Hand

Kind: component · Defined in [`src/logic/player/player.h`](../../../src/logic/player/player.h) · Described in `data/player.json`

Unity's Hand: a rigid body that follows a controller through a BodyDrive anchored on its player.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `player` | `entt::entity` | the player |
| `side` | `int` | VRInput::left (0) or right (1) |
| `failsafe` | `float` | m from its target beyond which it is put there (1) |
| `rest` | `glm::vec3` | pose before the controller is tracked, from the head, body frame |
| `tracked` | `bool` | the controller was trusted once |
| `position` | `glm::vec3` | last trusted controller position from the head, stage axes |
| `rotation` | `glm::quat` | last trusted controller rotation, stage axes |
| `velocity` | `glm::vec3` | last trusted controller velocity |
| `angular_velocity` | `glm::vec3` | last trusted angular velocity |
| `grip` | `float` | 0..1 |
| `trigger` | `float` | 0..1 |
| `teleports` | `int` | times the failsafe put it back (Grab lets go when it changes) |

## Notes

Its own entity with a dynamic RigidBody (1.5 kg box), a BodyDrive and a Grabber (makeVRPlayer). Written by VRHands.

## Systems that touch it

Read only by: Grab, PlayerModels. Written by: PlayerSpawn, VRHands. Created by: PlayerSpawn. Destroyed by: —.

| System | Kind | Scope | Access | Where | What it does with it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Grab](../systems/Grab.md) | system | Host | **read** | step, release, regroup | grip, side, player, teleports, velocity (thrown with it) |
| [PlayerModels](../systems/PlayerModels.md) | system | Host | **read** | tick | side: blue left, red right |
| [PlayerSpawn](../systems/PlayerSpawn.md) | system | Host | **write+create** | init (makeVRPlayer) | two hand entities, left and right, with their rest pose |
| [VRHands](../systems/VRHands.md) | system | Host | **readwrite** | step | player, side, failsafe, rest read; the last trusted controller state (tracked, position from the head, rotation, velocities, grip, trigger) written; teleports counted |

## Side effects of those systems

- **[Grab](../systems/Grab.md)**
  - Connects `on_destroy<RigidBody>` in preinit (disconnected in finish): the grips of a destroyed hand or object are taken off without a throw.
  - At each physics step: `CollideShape` of the hand's shape (max separation `touch`), `FixedConstraint` (priority 1000, 40 velocity / 8 position steps) added at the deepest contact; removed on release, teleport, finish.
  - On a throw: `SetLinearAndAngularVelocity` of the released body.
  - Sets and clears collision groups of grabbed bodies.
- **[PlayerModels](../systems/PlayerModels.md)**: none beyond its components.
- **[PlayerSpawn](../systems/PlayerSpawn.md)**
  - Creates entities: the player (and its two hands for VR) and `props` box entities in init; one Ground entity in preinit with `ground: true`.
  - No physics bodies itself: RigidBody (a later system) makes the Jolt bodies of the RigidBody components it adds.
- **[VRHands](../systems/VRHands.md)**
  - At each physics step: `SetPositionAndRotation` + `SetLinearAndAngularVelocity` of a hand more than `failsafe` from its target; `AddForce` of its share (by mass) of the legs' force.
  - Sets the collision group of each hand body once.
